title: Thawing, Expanding, and Freezing Human Fibroblasts
author: Jacob Marsh
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgunjwve
materials: Prior to thawing cells, prepare culture media
Aspirate hFibroblast Media from T25 cell culture flask
Re-suspend cell pellet in 1.5 mL hFibroblast Media.

steps.title: Prepare hFibroblast Media
steps.instruction: Prepare hFibroblast Media consisting of DMEM/F12, 10-20% FBS, 1% L-Glut (or Glutamax), and 1% Antibiotic.

steps.title: Thaw Human Fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Thaw cells quickly from liquid nitrogen storage using a 37 °C water bath.

substeps.instruction: Place vial in 37 °C water bath for approximately 00:01:00.
Remove vial from water bath just prior to complete thawing.

steps.title: Wash and Resuspend Thawed Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the thawed cells and resuspend them in growth media.

substeps.instruction: Quickly transfer thawed cells into a conical tube containing 9 mL of room temperature DMEM/F12.
Aspirate supernatant, taking care not to disturb the cell pellet.
Re-suspend cells in 5 mL of hFibroblast Media by pipetting up and down 2-3 times to achieve a single cell suspension.

steps.title: Initial Incubation
steps.instruction: Seed the cells and incubate overnight.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cell suspension to a T25 cell culture flask.
Incubate at 37 °C and 5% CO2 overnight.

steps.title: Split Confluent Fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Split cells once they reach 80-90% confluency (indicated by a swirling pattern).

substeps.instruction: Wash cells with 5 mL 1X PBS.
Add 1 mL of 0.25% Trypsin to cells and incubate at 37 °C for 00:05:00.
Check cells under a microscope; if many remain attached, incubate at 37 °C for an additional 00:05:00.
Re-suspend cells in 5 mL of hFibroblast Media, pipetting up and washing the flask 4-6 times to collect all cells and achieve a single cell suspension.
Add the cell suspension to 7 mL of fresh hFibroblast Media and transfer to a T75 cell culture flask (or two T25 flasks).
Incubate at 37 °C and 5% CO2 overnight.

steps.title: Maintain and Expand Cultures
steps.instruction: Maintain the culture until the cells are ready for further passage, experiments, or freezing.

substeps.instruction: Change media every 2-3 days until fibroblasts become confluent.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Freezing
steps.instruction: Harvest cells from a T75 flask at 80-90% confluency to prepare for banking.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells with 5 mL 1X PBS.
Add 2 mL of 0.25% Trypsin to cells and incubate at 37 °C for 00:05:00.
Re-suspend cells in 7 mL of hFibroblast Media, pipetting up and washing the flask 4-6 times to collect all cells and achieve a single cell suspension.
Transfer cell suspension to a conical tube for centrifugation.
Aspirate supernatant, taking care not to disturb the cell pellet.

steps.title: Freeze and Store Cells
steps.instruction: Cryopreserve the cells in freezing media and transfer to long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL 2X Freezing Media (FBS, 10% DMSO) to the cell suspension to reach a final volume of 3 mL.
Distribute 1 mL of the suspension into each of three pre-labeled cryovials.
Immediately place cryovials in a -80 °C freezer for 72:00:00.
Transfer cells to long-term liquid nitrogen storage.
